text:
elaine (Design): sharing a quick prototype for an alerting heatmap + channel stack ordering — trying to solve noisy channels when a single SLO fires repeatedly. thoughts?

sam (Product): neat! the heatmap idea could help users spot ‘frequent but low-severity’ vs ‘rare but high-severity’ incidents. what triggers the color scale? frequency or recentness?

elaine (Design): color = normalized firing frequency over the selected window (default 24h). border thickness = peak severity. hover shows a compact preview of the most recent alert and which conditions matched.

kevin (Eng): love the hover preview, but we need to be careful about perf for large projects. if heatmap renders per-channel, can we lazy-load tiles and only fetch preview payload on hover? (reaction: :gear:)

elaine (Design): yep lazy-load tiles is the plan. preview payload would be the same lightweight preview used in the existing notification preview panel. implementing a small debounce on hover to avoid spamming.

aria (A11y): a11y notes: heatmap must be keyboard navigable and have meaningful text equivalents. each tile should be focusable with aria-describedby linking to the preview content. also needs an aria-live region when preview content updates.

sam (Product): re copy — instead of "Notification preview" maybe use "Who will be notified" for clarity when the preview shows channel recipients. also suggest a small CTA: "Pin channel order" to let teams freeze a manual ordering vs the default severity sort.

kevin (Eng): how would pinning interact with rollouts? if someone pins a channel order on a project, do we persist that per-team or per-project? backend-wise per-project seems easiest.

elaine (Design): agree per-project. UI idea: pinned channels get a small pin icon and float to the top of the stack. unpinned channels still respect the heatmap ordering.

sam (Product): UX concern: new users might expect the preview to show an example payload for the channel type (Slack/email). recommend we label the preview "Example notification" and show a one-line copy snippet and recipient list.

aria (A11y): example notification needs text alternatives for screen-readers. for channel stack re-ordering, expose an "Edit order" mode so keyboard users get explicit instructions like: "Use arrow keys to move focused channel".

kevin (Eng): small implementation note: channel reordering + pin metadata will be a new field on the notification config API. example payload we discussed: 

```json
{
  "channels": [
    {"id": "c1", "type": "slack", "pinned": true, "order": 0},
    {"id": "c2", "type": "email", "pinned": false, "order": 1}
  ],
  "heatmap_window": "24h"
}
```

kevin (Eng): also recommend we add an endpoint that returns tile summaries only: {channel_id, freq_score, peak_severity, last_alert_snippet} so UI can render quickly.

elaine (Design): copy tweak: the threshold label currently reads "SLO breach window" — suggest "Evaluation window" with help text: "time window used to compute firing frequency and error budget burn". shorter and less jargon-y.

sam (Product): +1 on "Evaluation window". For new users we should default to 24h but show quick presets: 1h / 24h / 7d.

aria (A11y): final a11y nit: ensure color is not the sole channel for conveying severity — add a small dot pattern or icon overlay for high severity. contrast ratios must meet AA for the focus stroke.

elaine (Design): noted. I'll mock up a version with pinned channel treatment, hover debounce, keyboard reorder mode, and a11y overlays. posting a GIF in a follow-up thread.

notif-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled tomorrow 11:00am PT (blocks: design-review).

sam (Product): thanks everyone — please drop short comments if you see anything that will block implementation. otherwise i'll queue this for the next sprint. :rocket:
